hero.title: About us
paragraphs: We are Argentina's largest temporary apartment operator, with over 10 years of experience in hospitality and urban lodging.
We offer fully equipped hotel-standard apartments in strategic locations across Buenos Aires and Quito.

history.title: Our story
paragraphs: Top Rentals was founded in 2016 with the vision of professionalizing short-term rentals in Argentina, bringing hotel standards to urban apartments.
Since then we have grown to operate more than 500 units across 10 towers, serving corporate travelers, relocations, and business tourism.
In 2025 we continue expanding our network with new buildings and services designed for short, medium, and extended stays.
